{{Quote|I see you're awake.|The female medic, to Mara Jade|<ref name="TLCn" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''medic''' worked alongside members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Imperial Palace medical wing|medical wing]] of the former [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]]. She assisted former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] after the latter had awoken from a state of unconsciousness inflicted by a [[Battle for the Katana fleet|battle]] that had recently taken place. The [[Medic/Legends|medic]] made sure that Jade was feeling all right and that the latter's room in the palace was prepared for her.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Sorry. I guess I'm a little disoriented.''"<br />"''Understandable. You've been lying in that bed for a month, after all.''"<br />"''A ''month''?''"<br />"''Well, most of a month. You also spent some time in a bacta tank. Don't worry&mdash;short-term memory problems are common during neural reconstructions, but they nearly always clear up after the treatment.|Mara Jade and the female medic|<ref name="TLCn" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last Command]]'' to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] worked as a [[Medic/Legends|medic]] in the [[Imperial Palace medical wing|medical wing]] of the old [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Working alongside other members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the medic assisted former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] after the latter had awoken from an unconscious state caused by a recent [[Battle for the Katana fleet|battle]].<ref name="TLCn" />

Assisted by an [[Unidentified 2-1B surgical droid (Imperial Palace)|Emdee droid]], the medic examined Jade's bandaged forehead with a [[Bioscan/Legends|medical scanning device]] since Jade had just awoken from [[Brain/Legends|neural]] reconstruction. As Jade was suffering from short-term memory loss, the medic assisted her by briefly telling the former [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] Hand what had happened during her stay in the [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]]. The medic noted that Jade had been in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] and then had lain in a bed for just short of a [[Standard month/Legends|month]]. After the medic informed Jade of what had happened, the former used a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to make certain that Jade's quarters in the palace were prepared for her. Shortly thereafter, Jade was taken to her room by [[Winter Celchu|Winter]], a personal friend of New Republic official [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].<ref name="TLCn" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We have a guest suite arranged for you upstairs whenever you feel ready to leave here. Would you like me to see if it's ready?|The female medic, to Mara Jade|<ref name="TLCn" />}}
At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of Jade's visit to the hospital, the female medic was a middle-aged woman with fair skin who was professional in her work. She was willing to be thorough in her job such that she took good care of Jade, making sure that the latter's room was prepared for her, for example.<ref name="TLCn" />

==Equipment==
At the time that she tended to Jade, the medic wore a [[Color/Legends|green]]-and-white duty medic's tunic with a matching green-and-white [[Hat/Legends|hat]] and carried a comlink.<ref name="TLC1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The medic first appeared in the [[1993]] novel ''[[The Last Command]]'', the last installment of [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''.<ref name="TLCn" /> She was later pictured in [[The Last Command 1|''The Last Command'' 1]], the first part of the [[1997]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] [[Star Wars: The Last Command (comic series)|adaptation]] of ''The Last Command''. ''The Last Command 1'' was written by [[Mike Baron]], illustrated by [[Edvin Biuković]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="TLC1" /> on [[November 26]], [[1997]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54611/star_wars_the_last_command_1997_1|text=Star Wars: The Last Command (1997) #1}}</ref>
